Deer Overview
Deer
is a common
Beast Form
. Druids eventually unlock the ability to shift in and out of Deer Form at will, and other players can transform themselves with Deer/Undeer Juice. The last option for becoming a deer is taking a rage attack from
Ciervos The Shadow
, and defeating him will uncurse you.
Deer are typically solid bruisers/offtanks. They can provide decent self-healing and have the ability to summon a deer pet. Deer also have access to potent movement speed buffs.
Being a deer means you look harmless to other animals, so enemy deer and similar animals don’t run away from you.
For more information on how to navigate being turned into an animal visit the
Beast Forms
page for advice.
In-Game Description
The art of living and fighting as a deer.
Training Deer
The
Deer Form
ability is unlocked automatically by
Druids
at level 25
The dark elk
Ciervos The Shadow
will curse deer form unto anyone hit by his rage attack
Drinking a
Deer Juice
will turn you into a deer.
Yetta
in Eltibule Keep sells both the Deer and Un-Deer potions, but it should be noted that she will not speak to animals. Thus, if you are a deer in need of an
Un-Deer Juice
, you may need a humanoid friend to buy it from her for you.
Jumper
will unlock levels 51-70 and train 51+ abilities
Noita the Green
unlocks 71-80.
Levels 81-90 are unlocked by
Big Footed Jim
deep beneath
Povus
.
Note: Druids looking to train deer skills with Jumper will need to stay in
Deer
(or other beast-form, not including bird forms) for at least three in-game hours before Jumper will speak with you.

Deer Mechanics
Lack of Hands
Playing as a deer you lack the ability to cut wood, milk cows or use
Sigil Scripting
, like a deer needs to do those things anyway.
NPC Communication
Some NPCs may interact with harmless animals (eg Deer), but a considerable number flat-out refuse to speak with any non-humanoids. Others may require a bribe or favor to open their minds to the fact you're more than some filthy animal. A list showing what NPC's will and will not communicate with you can be found on the
Beast Forms
page.
Riding
As a
Beast Form
, Deer are not able to use the traditional Horse mounts offered through
Riding
. Instead,
Silvia
in
Sun Vale
teaches a mount-form to
Deer
players who are at least level 25, as well as a speed-up ability that reduces mount anxiety and increases jump height.
Diet
Currently what you eat doesn't really change your experience as a deer, though eating meals prepared from deer meat may leave you with a guilty conscious but they probably deserved it anyway so enjoy.
Drugs & Enhancements
As an animal, there's a number of items you're able to consume to help you become the best deer possible. One of these magical substances is known as
Bounceweed
and has no negative effects what so ever...unless you stop taking it. If your tiny ruminant mind is tired and overwhelmed with bounceweed addiction a friendly mantis called
Yavazek
will barter you some
Calmweed
putting you on the road to recovery.
Jumping
The ability
Bounding Escape
gives deer a considerable boost in jumping capability, allowing you to reach ledges, avoid obstacles or hungry predators.
Summon Deer
A PC deer can summon one companion deer at level 12 using the skill
Summon Deer
.  This ability can be used out of deer form, but the Deer skillset must be active.
